name: Showing a Video stream from a web based camera - General Discussion
snippet: You need Motion JPEG (mjpeg or mjpg) or JPEG stills (jpeg or jpg). Both send full JPEG images at once. MPEG is a completely different protocol.

name: A list of supported MJPEG IP cameras
snippet: The most common URL format (IP address) is "http://xx.xx.xx.xx/axis-cgi/mjpg/video.cgi". You can try using this URL in the first setup of the camera.

name: [All cameras] What is the HTTP URL to play the camera's MJPEG stream?
snippet: Go to System > Network to view the HTTP & HTTPS settings. Under "Allow access through" clone, select "HTTP" to display the corresponding access name.
